cards.mood: The piece opens with a somber, cinematic introspection driven by piano and strings, establishing a mood of quiet resilience.
cards.palette: A grand piano anchors the harmonic foundation throughout the track, playing arpeggiated figures in the intro and verses before switching to block chords in the choruses.

cards.mood: The track launches immediately with high-energy triumph and anthemic grandeur, maintaining a relentless forward momentum through the verses.
cards.palette: Heavily distorted electric guitars serve as the core harmonic and melodic driver, playing power-chord rhythms and melodic riffs from the Intro to the Outro.
